definition: חַשְׁמַל noun [masculine] etymology and exact meaning dubious; evidently some shining substance; AV amber; supposed by Thes (q. v.) and most to be a brilliant amalgam of gold and silver, ᵐ5 ἤλεκτρον (see Liddell & Scott under the word 2 ), ᵑ9 electrum ; see also Dl in Baer Ezech. xii ; only in the combination ׳ כְּעֵין ח like the appearance of ׳ ח Ezek 1:4 ; Ezek 1:27 בְּעֵין הַחַשְׁמַ֑לָה Ezek 8:2 (on ending הָ֯ see Ges «GKC:90»§ 90 , 2 R a; Co strike out)
